_readme: Comics archive manifest. One entry per strip; the page sorts newest first by date. Add strips with: python3 tools/add-strips.py <folder>, then fill in episode/title/alt.

strips.title: The Flyer Relay
strips.alt: Six-panel comic. Bryan needs a flyer by noon; Moth sketches, Pip pitches sticky-note ideas, Vesper approves, Noodle rides an office chair to Dot's print shop, and the crew cheers the finished flyer stack while Grimble juggles three headsets.

strips.title: Moth's Night Out
strips.alt: Comic strip about the gremlins' team outing: karaoke, and Moth drawing everyone, though nobody remembers posing.

strips.title: First Day
strips.alt: Comic strip: the Grateful Gremlins' first day at the office.
